fichas.title: Bell Towers
fichas.summary: Bell-tower design involves bell specialists, bell founders, and structural engineers in establishing bell size and pitch, bell-frame layout, sound openings, and structural loadings. The belfry should be above surrounding buildings and is an enclosed resonance and mixing space apart from its sound openings. Its construction and acoustic design affect tone and sound transmission. Sound shutters should provide many small openings at right angles to the bell swing; sound transmission should be directed to protect the neighbourhood.

Design
The standards on bell towers should be complied with.
A bell specialist can provide advice about the size and pitch of
the bells, acoustics and weights. A bell founder designs the bell
frame as the basis for the dimensions and layout of the belfry and
sound openings, and also contributes loadings for the structural
engineer, who has to consider static and dynamic loadings.
